QuestInfo.name: Little Crystal Factories
QuestInfo.0: Ask the Insignificant Being about the crystal.
QuestInfo.1: The Insignificant Being says you need to defeat the big Taurospears in the deepest depths of the Cursed Temple to get the crystal. Bring 10 Crystal Fragments to him.
QuestInfo.2: You got what you need for the barrier. Return to Vieren.

0.0: Bring me the crystals and I'll cleanse them of the curse.\r\n#L0##bWhere can I get these crystals?#l\n#k
0.1: Try hunting the Taurospears in the deepest reaches of the temple. They must have the broken pieces of the crystal. I'd say 10 Crystal Fragments should be enough.

yes.0: Bring me 10 Crystal Fragments and I'll drive out their evil energy.

no.0: No need for the crystal anymore? Do you want all your efforts to go to waste?

1.0: Ahh, the Crystal Fragments. Let me see them, and I will cleanse them.

yes.0: Good. The evil is no more. Go, and use this crystal as you will.

item.0: I'll cleanse the crystal when you bring me 10 Crystal Fragments.
